title: Debye Relaxation in Model-Based Multi-Dimensional Magnetic Particle Imaging
summary: Model-based reconstruction approaches for the medical imaging modality Magnetic Particle Imaging (MPI) are typically based on the Langevin model, which assumes instantaneous alignment of the particles magnetic momenta with the applied field. Regarding the application to real data, Langevin model-based reconstruction methods require model transfer functions (MTF) obtained from calibrations to preprocess the data. There are also model-based reconstruction approaches that include relaxation effects and other particle-level dynamics. However, they are limited either to 1D or 1D-like scanning…
